_comment: Operator data for the imprint and the privacy policy, read at runtime (no rebuild needed). Every value in [brackets] is a placeholder; the legal pages show a draft banner while any remain. The texts are templates and not legally reviewed: have them checked by the operator's data protection officer before going live.
content_responsible: [Name und Anschrift der inhaltlich verantwortlichen Person]
